>> What can Pickleball Simulator do for you?

Digital pickleball is an interactive digital sports simulator blending competition with entertainment. It delivers diverse 

gameplay—from AI matches and pro training to relaxing puzzle modes—enabling automated, high-margin revenue 

without extra staffing while tracking burnt calories and shot performance. It is ideal for commercial arcades, indoor 

sports centers, and Family Entertainment Centers (FECs).


>>Why Digital pickleball is Your Venue Transformation Catalyst

  • Maximise Revenue & ROI: Built-in coin-op and card-swipe payment options with customisable pricing. Easily

  • switch between free-play, pay-per-game, or timed rental modes.

  • Zero Staffing Required: Fully automated ball-serving machine with smart sensor tracking, automated scoring,

  • and real-time game state management.

  • High Player Retention & Throughput: Fast 3-minute average game cycles keep queues moving while exciting

  • multi-mode gameplay ensures high repeat-play rates.

  • Flexible Footprint & Quick Setup: Fully adjustable serving angles and launch speeds allow seamless installation

  • in standard 4.5m wide courts or custom arcade spaces.


>> Advantages and Applications for the Pickleball Simulator:



  • Whether catering to serious sports enthusiasts, families, or party groups, Digital Pickleball features 5 distinct game modes engineered for engagement:

  • AI Match Mode: Play realistic competitive pickleball against dynamic AI opponents. Features 3 immersive court environments (Red Clay, Hard Court, Grass Court), multiple difficulty levels, and realistic tennis-style scoring.

  • Professional Training Mode: Attract sports enthusiasts with structured practice modules. Includes Forehand, Backhand, Volley, and Free Rally modes with customisable ball launch intervals and performance analytics.

  • Match-3 Puzzle Challenge : Players hit interactive digital targets to trigger match-3 style puzzle chain reactions.

Built-In Business & Revenue Management System

Designed with venue operators in mind, our secure backend menu gives you total control over your business operations:

  • Customisable Payment Logic: Set custom price-per-play or integrate with digital magnetic card readers.

  • Password-Protected Operator Settings: Prevent unauthorised tampering with secured pricing and hardware controls.

  • Post-Game Analytics & Leaderboards: Displays burnt calories, return heatmaps, and ball speed metrics after every

  • round. Local leaderboard integration drives competitive replayability among customers.

  • Automated Attract Mode: Plays promotional videos during idle periods to attract foot traffic across your venue floor.

>> FAQs for Pickleball Simulator:

Q1: How easy is pickleball simulator to adjust the hardware to fit my space?

A1: Operators can fine-tune top-wheel launch speeds, horizontal angles (10–70 scope), and vertical pitch directly to fit 10m 

or custom court layouts seamlessly.


Q2: Can I run this without charging coins or cards?

A2: Yes. The payment system can be close in the settings for free-play events, corporate rentals, or fixed hourly facility 

access.


Q3: What warranty and software support are provided?

A3: Guangzhou Liangjia Sports Technology (LJ Sports Tech) holds full independent R&D patents for ball launchers and 

trajectory tracking positioning. We deliver full original hardware setups (including industrial host PC, Epson projector, IR 

sensors, high-speed camera, and high-impact impact screen) alongside long-term software updates and technical support.

Provide on-site installation by our staff and offer a one-year free warranty.


Q4: Is the equipment durable enough for heavy commercial usage?

A4: Yes, the system uses high-precision industrial camera tracking, robust impact screens, and commercial-grade 

ball-dispensing units built for high-volume commercial environments.
